scripts.setup: node server/scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm run db:reset -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n idp,api,web -c magenta,cyan,yellow "npm run idp -w server" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.start: concurrently -n idp,api -c magenta,cyan "npm run idp -w server" "npm run start -w server"
